sources.title: Phantomcloak19/gemma-dpo-full · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This Gemma-2 (2B) model has been fine-tuned using Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) to reduce hallucinations and improve factual consistency, trained on the Unified Hallucination Benchmark. The model was trained ~2× faster using Unsloth, enabling efficient low-VRAM fine-tuning.
